Let requisite compliances be made within 01 week.
The application stands disposed of.

By way of the present petition filed under sections 438/482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure 1973 ('Cr.P.C.'), the petitioner seeks anticipatory bail in case FIR No. 84/2023 dated 07.02.2023 registered under sections 376/354(A)/506/509/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 at P.S.: Jamia Nagar.
2. At the outset, it is noticed that the complainant/prosecutrix has been impleaded as party-respondent No.2 in the petition.
In view of the decision of this court in Saleem vs. State & Anr reported as 2023 DHC 2622, the said respondent is deleted from the array of party respondents.

sentences.text:
3. Let amended memo of parties be filed within 01 week.
4.

Mr. M. Hasibuddin, learned counsel appearing for the petitioner submits, that the petitioner has not been named in either the FIR or the MLC of the prosecutrix, who (latter) is the wife of the petitioner's cousin.

Counsel submits that the subject FIR is a counter-blast to an earlier FIR bearing No. 73/2023 dated 01.02.2023 which was registered at the petitioner's instance against the prosecutrix, in connection with disputes that had arisen from the matrimonial discord between the petitioner's cousin and the prosecutrix.

5. It is pointed-out, that the petitioner has been named by the prosecutrix by way of an afterthought in her statements recorded under sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C.

sentences.text: 6. Issue notice.
7. Mr. Shoaib Haider, learned APP appears for the State on advance copy; accepts notice; and seeks time to file status report.
8. Let status report be filed within 06 weeks; with copy to the opposing counsel.
Rejoinder thereto, if any, be filed within 04 weeks thereafter.

9. Let intimation under section 439(1-A) Cr.P.C. read with the Delhi High Court Practice Directions dated 24.09.2019 in form Annexure-A attached to the Practice Directions, be sent by the Investigating Officer to the complainant, informing her that she is entitled to be heard in the present bail petition, for which she may remain present (either in-person or via video-conferencing) or be represented on the next date.
10. Re-notify on 13th September 2023.

11. In the meantime, subject to the petitioner joining investigation as and when called by the Investigating Officer by written notice, the petitioner shall not be arrested, till the next date of hearing.
